subject: AtlasPath - pricing packet and short clarification call
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@atlaspath.ai>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@atlaspath.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasPath - pricing packet and short clarification call

Hi Elena / Tom — great to speak this morning. Thanks again for walking through AtlasPath's latency and retention constraints; that context helped shape the numbers in the attached packet.

Summary from our call (quick):
- Primary use case: real-time routing + embeddings for search (90% of calls under 512 tokens)
- Desired latency: p95 < 150ms for single-token responses, batching for bulk exports
- Data controls: VPC + customer-managed KMS preferred for production

Attached: high-level pricing packet (PDF) and an editable SOW draft. Highlights in the packet: a recommended Dedicated configuration for predictable throughput, burst plan for spikes, and estimated monthly unit costs.

Can you confirm you received both attachments? If helpful I can run through the packet in a tight 10‑minute call to point at the assumptions and where you might tune to lower unit cost. Suggested slots I have this week: Thu 08/27 9:30–10:00am PT, Fri 08/28 2:00–2:30pm PT. If none of those work, send two windows that do.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachments: 20260826_Redwood_Pricing-AtlasPath.pdf (PDF), SOW-draft-AtlasPath.docx (DOCX)

Two quick options: Thu 09/02 11:00–11:10am PT or Fri 09/03 10:00–10:10am PT. If you'd prefer, tell me a time that fits and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Appreciate any signal on where this sits in your timeline.

Best,
Kimberly
